children: The International Monetary Fund and Zimbabwe's authorities reached a staff-level agreement on the second review of a 10-month staff-monitored programme, the IMF said on Thursday.

"Programme implementation through end-June 2026 was strong. All quantitative and indicative targets were met except the indicative target on protected social and priority spending," the IMF said in its statement.
